paragraphs.text: When a man has once given place to evil counsel, or to his own sin nature, he begins to forget himself in his sin, and so falls into contempt of God, which is called the seat of the scorners.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: God's children are so moistened with his grace, that whatever comes to them, tends to their salvation.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Though the wicked seem to prosper in this world, yet the Lord drives them down that they shall not rise nor stand in the company of the righteous.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: But tremble when they see God's wrath.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Approves and prospers, in the same way that to not know is to reprove and reject.
paragraphs.label: f
paragraphs.anchor: knoweth the way of the righteous
